title: Ayam Suwir Santan - Shredded Chicken in Coconut Milk
ldName: Ayam Suwir Santan - Shredded Chicken in Coconut Milk
ldIngredientsRaw: 2 chicken breasts (~ 450 gram/1 lb), cut into thin slices
3 Indonesian bay leaves (Indonesian: daun salam), omit if you don't have these
2 teaspoon palm sugar (Indonesian: gula Jawa), or use coconut sugar
2 candlenuts (Indonesian: kemiri), or an equal amount of macadamia
2 lemongrass (Indonesian: sereh), white parts from lower 3 inches of lemongrass stalks (*)
ldInstructionsRaw: Cook the chicken. Place thinly sliced chicken breast, along with the rest of the ingredients, in a pot. Bring to a boil, then cover the pot, and simmer until the chicken is fully cooked. About 15 minutes.
Shred the chicken. Remove chicken pieces from the broth. Shred with a pair of forks. Arrange the shredded chicken in a serving platter.
Strain the broth. Strain the broth to get a clear soup, then boil the strained broth.
Serve shredded chicken with strained broth. Pour the strained broth over the shredded chicken, and serve immediately with steamed white rice.
